title: Aladdin and the magic lamp.
lines: Far away, in a hot land with lots of sand and high sand dunes, there is a busy city.
There are markets full of fruit, carpets and pots.
And camels walk through the streets.
A clever boy lives in that city.
He has no house and no money.
But he does have a big heart.
And he has a best buddy: a little monkey!
Abu wears a little red vest and a little hat.
He always sits on Aladdin's shoulder.
And sometimes Abu secretly grabs a banana or an apple at the market.
A princess lives in the palace.
She has a big tiger as a pet, called Rajah.
Jasmine is bored in the palace.
So one day she dresses up and sneaks to the market.
But a wicked sorcerer also lives in the palace.
He has a long black beard and a snake staff, and on his shoulder sits a red parrot called Iago.
Jafar wants to be the boss of all of Agrabah.
Jafar knows there is a secret cave in the desert.
A cave in the shape of a big lion's head.
And in that cave lies an old, dusty oil lamp.
But only someone with a good heart may go inside.
Aladdin and Abu go into the cave.
There is gold and jewels and treasure everywhere.
But Abu sees a big red diamond.
And then everything starts to shake.
Luckily they find a friend: a magic flying carpet!
A real carpet, with golden tassels, that can fly and wave with its corners.
But they are stuck in the dark.
Smoke comes out of the lamp.
And out of the smoke comes a big, funny blue Genie!
A giant, with a tail of smoke instead of legs.
Ten thousand years in that lamp gives you a stiff neck!
He turns into a chicken, an elephant, a teacher and a dragon.
You are my new master, says the Genie.
But you can't wish for someone to fall in love with you, and you can't wish for more wishes!
He gets the Genie to take them out of the cave without using a wish.
Then Aladdin makes his first wish.
I wish to become a prince!
Aladdin becomes Prince Ali, with a big parade of elephants and camels and music.
In the evening Aladdin goes to Jasmine's balcony.
Jasmine steps onto the flying carpet.
And they fly through the sky together!
High above the clouds, past the stars, over the pyramids and over the sea.
She recognises Aladdin from the market.
But wicked Jafar steals the magic lamp.
Now Jafar is the Genie's master!
He becomes the most powerful sorcerer.
Ha ha ha, he laughs nastily.
Jafar, he says, the Genie is much stronger than you!
Then I wish to become a Genie!
But all Genies have to live in a lamp!
Jafar gets sucked into a black lamp.
And the Genie throws that lamp far, far away.
Genie, I wish for you to be free!
He dances and jumps for joy.
And the sultan says Aladdin may marry Jasmine.
They fly together on the carpet to the moon.
Abu gets all the bananas he wants.
